## Subjective

29yo F, no significant PMH except occasional UTIs (~1/yr), presents with 2-day h/o dysuria (location: bladder area; quality: burning; severity: 6/10; duration: 2 days; timing: throughout day; modifying factors: minimal relief w/ cranberry juice; associated symptoms: increased urinary frequency). Denies fever, flank pain, hematuria, vaginal discharge. LMP 2 weeks ago, no chance of pregnancy (LARC). Tobacco: never. SHx: monogamous relationship.

## Objective

VS: BP 116/72, HR 82, T 98.6°F. Gen: NAD. Abdomen: soft, suprapubic tenderness present, no CVA tenderness. UA in-office: 3+ leukocytes, 2+ nitrites, trace blood, negative protein, negative glucose, negative ketones.

## Assessment

1. Acute uncomplicated cystitis (N30.00)

## Plan

UA confirms UTI. Started nitrofurantoin 100mg PO BID × 5 days. Push fluids. Patient counseled to return for fever, flank pain, persistent symptoms beyond 48 hours, or vomiting. F/u PRN. Reviewed allergy hx — no contraindications. Discussed prophylaxis options if pattern continues.
